import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_22/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_22/training_1.csv"

df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source5_22_0 and Source5_22_1 on "school_name"
df_joined = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Operation 2: GROUP BY Source5_22_1.school_name, aggregating sum of math_score from Source5_22_1
# After join, math_score column is from Source5_22_1, so we use df_joined['math_score']
df_grouped = df_joined.groupby("school_name", as_index=False)["math_score"].sum()

# Ensure the schema matches target schema: ['school_name': string, 'math_score': integer]
df_grouped["school_name"] = df_grouped["school_name"].astype(str)
df_grouped["math_score"] = df_grouped["math_score"].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_22/target_multisource.csv"
df_grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_22/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source5_22_0 and Source5_22_1 on school_name
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on='school_name', right_on='school_name')

# Group by school_name and sum math_score
result = joined.groupby('school_name', as_index=False)['math_score'].sum()

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
